data: What is the approximate value of the number of entries for the rightmost plot in 2007?

The rightmost plot represents the TrEMBL database. The x-axis shows the Database Release Date, and the y-axis shows the Number of Entries. The data points are red circles. The rightmost point on the x-axis corresponds to approximately 2007. The y-axis value at this point is around 3000. Therefore, the approximate value of the number of entries for the rightmost plot in 2007 is 3000.
